claim: The declared evidence directory exempted arbitrary executable files from changed-file checks.
evidence: evals/final/rogue.py was ignored while the evidence directory was declared.
impact: Unreviewed executable code could influence verification without appearing in the Artifact file hashes.
required_action: Limit directory exemptions to canonical JSON records and require exact paths for all other evidence files.

prevention.action: Restrict evidence-directory exemptions to JSON records and exact declared files.
